text:
lucy: Heads up 5m: ops flagged confusion around our automatic fallback rollback behavior. They hit an auto-rollback (contingency -> previous model) and weren't sure who/what triggered it. Asking for: RBAC for undo, cooldown timers, and clearer audit export. thoughts?

devon: RBAC good. we should block the UI "Undo" for anyone without rollout_write, and require an audit comment when undoing. Also add a 2-minute cooldown window after an auto-rollback before another automatic action can fire (to avoid flip-flop).

priya: +1. For the console microcopy: call it "manual revert" vs "automatic recovery" so non-engineering folks don't confuse. Show the actor (bot vs user) prominently. We should also show which trigger evaluated true (eg: infra_5xx, p95_ms) with a tiny sparkline.

kevin: telemetry note: when we do an automatic rollback we must emit event: job=contingency-controller, type=auto_rollback, fields: rollout_id, trigger_id, sampled_inputs_hashes[], prev_model, new_model, actor=system. keep retention 90d by default.

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert -> auto-rollback executed for rollout 1740012345 at 1740012388 (trigger=infra_5xx>1.5%). details -> https://internal.logs/rollouts/1740012345

lucy: nice. also ops asked for CSV export shape for audits. devon can we make it include: timestamp, actor, action, trigger, sample_count, sample_hashes, cost_delta_est?

devon: yes. example CSV header: `ts,actor,action,trigger,window_s,samples,cost_delta_tokens,notes`

priya: privacy: sampling must be optional at rollout-level and disabled by default for enterprise tenants. if sampling enabled we must hash+salt inputs and store only first 64 chars of hash. Add a warning in the modal: "Sensitive inputs may be collected" with link to policy.

kevin: API design: propose POST /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/actions with body: `{ "action": "undo", "reason": "manual review", "dry_run": false }`. Server returns an operation id and emits audit. Also support `?simulate=true` query that doesn't change routing but emits the same audit events (marked simulated).

lucy: can we also make the pill ephemeral? Show a compact pill in the route header: [auto-recovered ▶ cheaper-quant-v3 | infra_5xx] — clicking opens timeline with the CSV/export and a "Revert (manual)" CTA gated by RBAC.

ops-bot: ops-bot: note -> rollout 1740012345 triggered contingency at 1740012370, auto-rollback at 1740012388, routed 90/900 to fallback between those times.

devon: edgecase: if rollback was auto and later a human reverts it back, timeline must reflect both actions and who initiated them. Playback simulator should be able to replay exact event order for debugging.

priya: playback also needs to surface model-output diffs for a small sample (if capture enabled). Format: store JSONL snapshots with `input_hash`, `before_tokens`, `after_tokens`, `diff_score` (simple token-level mismatch). Retention follow tenant settings.

kevin: we should add a failure-safe: if undo action fails due to hot capacity, record a pending_undo audit event and surface the failure reason in pill. ops can click "Retry" when capacity frees up.

lucy: UX nit: avoid banners. show toast for the operator who took action + pill for everyone else. Automated actions should add a subtle 'system' badge so PMs won't think a human did it.

devon: implementation: small DB table `rollout_audits` with (id string, rollout_id string, ts int, actor string, action string, metadata string). expose via GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/audit?limit=100. Add `simulated` boolean field in metadata.

priya: compliance: exports must redact sample_hashes unless requester has audit_read_with_samples role. Add checkbox in export modal: "Include sampled inputs (PII risk)" and warn.

ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI -> kube job `contingency-controller` will emit metrics `contingency.events_total{action="auto_rollback"}` and `contingency.active_rollouts`

lucy: ok owners: @devon implement API + RBAC changes, @priya add sampling/PII toggles & playback support, @kevin wire telemetry and retention defaults. i'll do a quick FigJam mock for pill + timeline.

kevin: one more: cost delta calc should be approximate tokens/wk or $/1M reqs. small estimate in pill like "+0.6 tokens/req (~$0.02/1k)". good for product signals.

devon: logging curl for audit: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.api.internal/rollouts/1740012345/audit?format=csv"`

priya: will add feature flag to gate sample capture for enterprise compliance while we iterate.

lucy: thanks all. i'll commit the design doc + tracking ticket. will @mention when mock ready. :white_check_mark:
